title: Peru approves National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030 requiring public entities to align
date_note: Exitosa gives the day of publication in the official gazette El Peruano (24 Nov); the resolution itself was not read.
org: Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros (PCM), Peru
summary: Exitosa reports that Peru’s PCM approved the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030 by Resolución Ministerial 384-2026-PCM, published 24 November in El Peruano. Public entities must align objectives and actions with its priorities; Exitosa describes an Oficial de Seguridad y Confianza Digital who coordinates security actions in each entity. Exitosa says progress is checked every six months and non-compliance carries administrative, civil and criminal liability, as applicable.
plain: Peru’s government approved a 2026-2030 cybersecurity strategy; public bodies must align with it, according to Exitosa.
exec: Exitosa reports Peruvian public entities, and entities under FONAFE, must follow the new strategy.
impact: Applies to public administration entities and public enterprises of regional and local governments, per Exitosa.

validation.note: Two independent publishers (Exitosa (Peru) and Correo Peru) each report the PCM's approval of the strategy; the El Peruano resolution text was not found.

review.note: stronger than the source: removed 'must appoint' an Oficial de Seguridad y Confianza Digital (Exitosa only describes the role); other facts match Exitosa, Correo, Andina
